titre_page: How do I make an object a child of another? | Yop2D guide
description: Learn to link objects in Yop2D: a child follows its parent. Two methods, through the Inspector or by dragging in the Hierarchy, plus the editor top bar.
h1: How do I make an object a child of another?
carte: A child follows its parent: it moves, rotates and scales with it. Two ways to link them.
etapes: Select the object that will be the child.
Long-press the child, then drop it on the **Scene** line or on a folder. It keeps its place on screen.
blocs: A **child** is an object attached to a **parent**: move the parent and the child follows. Handy for text on a button, a weapon in a hand, a shadow under a character.

The top bar is the same on tablet and phone (on phone only the icons are shown): **＋ Object**, **Assets**, **Save**, **Undo**, **Redo**, **Copy**, **Delete**, **Move**, **View ▾** (hand, grid, center, zoom), **Blueprint**, **Menu** and **Play**.
Select the object that will be the child.
Open the Inspector (arrow at the top right if it is closed), **Advanced** section.
Tap the **Parent** line and pick the parent object in the list.
Press and hold the child object until it lifts off.
Drop it **on the parent object**: the parent gets a green outline and the child appears below it with the **└** symbol.
Long-press the child, then drop it on the **Scene** line or on a folder. It keeps its place on screen.
Both methods give the same result: the Inspector and the Hierarchy always agree. A child's coordinates are counted from its parent's top-left corner. Two objects cannot be each other's parent.
